title: Semester Performance Overview
content: The overall performance this semester has been impressive, with a marked improvement in test scores and participation. The introduction of interactive learning sessions has had a positive impact. Notably, student John Smith (ID: 112233) achieved a GPA of 3.9, the highest in the class. The majority of students have shown great enthusiasm for the new curriculum.

title: Class GPA Distribution
content: The GPA distribution for the class shows a positive skew, with more students achieving above-average grades. The median GPA is 3.2, and the mode is 3.1. The new teaching methods have been well received, and students have been more engaged during lectures and discussions.
